purpose: Canonical replaceable-unit catalogue for spares, repair, ship construction and later frame integration.

geometry_rule.note: Dimensions are equipment replaceable-unit envelopes, not hull frames. Cobrett runtime geometry anchors are preserved; other sizes are scaled from declared mass/power using the same effective-density philosophy as ship_designer.py.

policy: A more powerful standard drive may replace a weaker unit and is software/power limited to the ship's rated thrust/input.
Large reactor ratings may be built from parallel banks of a smaller standard reactor; bank power is limited to the ship passport rating.
Standardization never changes the ship's rated thrust or required electrical input without an explicit later design decision.
Frame and mount geometry are deliberately not canonical yet; only equipment envelopes and service clearances are provided.
